prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 中文 · 员工花名册 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "工号" · longest unbreakable word 53px · one-line width 53px
  col 2: header "姓名" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 62px
  col 3: header "部门" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "职级" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "入职日期" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 85px
  col 6: header "主要职责" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 491px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"用于查阅员工花名册，关联工号、姓名、部门、职级、入职日期与主要职责。","reading":"读者先按姓名或工号定位员工，再横向读取其部门、职级、入职日期和职责；也可能纵向比较部门、职级或入职时间。职责较长，会决定多数行的高度，其他字段可利用这些行高适度换行。","groups":["工号和姓名共同标识员工。","部门和职级共同描述员工的组织位置。","入职日期是便于纵向比较的时间信息。","主要职责是解释岗位工作的长文本，与其余简短字段的阅读方式不同。"],"keep_intact":["工号应保持在一行，便于识别和核对。","职级代码应保持完整。","入职日期宜保持完整；若空间不足，应避免拆开数字段。"],"may_wrap":["姓名可在汉字之间换行，但应尽量保持完整，尤其是四字姓名。","部门名称可按汉字自然换行。","主要职责可自然换行，其产生的行高可容纳其他字段换行。","入职日期在必要时可在连字符处换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [74, 53, 53, 40, 64, 75] · table 360×963px · row heights [60, 269, 83, 222, 246, 83] · column headers wrapped 3/6 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [74, 68, 43, 40, 64, 70] · table 360×1056px · row heights [60, 269, 129, 222, 246, 129] · column headers wrapped 4/6 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [74, 53, 43, 40, 72, 77] · table 360×1056px · row heights [60, 269, 129, 222, 246, 129] · column headers wrapped 4/6 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"工号和职级代码完整；姓名、部门基本以两字为一行，短字段仍能与职责对应成行。三个方案中部门和职责的宽度配合最好，短职责的两行员工记录也较紧凑。","problems":"职级、入职日期和主要职责的表头换行；较长职责逐字堆叠，阅读费力。第三位员工的日期分成三行，不利于纵向比较。","cause":"40px 的职级列和 75px 的职责列容不下各自表头；64px 日期列只有 43px 文本空间，部分日期在连字符处需要额外换行。职责列仅有 54px 文本空间，长句因此形成很多短行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"较宽的姓名列让多数三字姓名保持一行，工号和职级代码也完整。","problems":"部门表头和部门名称几乎逐字竖排，短职责所在的员工记录也被部门拉高；职责仍然狭窄，日期仍有三行。姓名列获得的空间没有改善整表节奏。","cause":"68px 的姓名列占用了部门与职责可用的空间；43px 部门列只有 22px 文本空间，而 70px 职责列只有 49px。日期列仍为 64px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"72px 的日期列使示例日期都能分成较整齐的两行；工号和职级代码保持完整。","problems":"部门逐字竖排并拉高短职责的行；姓名和多个表头仍换行，职责也仍然形成很短的行。日期的改善不足以补偿部门可读性的损失。","cause":"43px 的部门列只有 22px 文本空间；53px 姓名列无法容纳多数三字姓名。日期列增至 72px 后，职责列仍只有 77px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[74,51,51,40,64,79],"change":"以 r1A 为基础，姓名和部门各收窄 2px，将 4px 转给职责。两列仍各有 30px 文本空间，尝试保留两字一行的节奏，同时让长职责多一点呼吸空间。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[74,53,51,40,68,73],"change":"从部门和职责各借 2px 给日期，检验 68px 是否能减少日期的三行换行，同时保留部门两字一行和 r1A 的姓名宽度。"},{"name":"r2C","widths":[74,53,53,40,60,79],"change":"将日期列的 4px 转给职责，探索优先改善长文本的方案；需检查 39px 日期文本空间是否会拆开数字段，以及由此造成的阅读代价。"}]}
